title: Submission deadlines.
officialText:
Except as otherwise provided in section 28-305.4.6, the registered design
professional shall submit a written report to the commissioner within 60 days of completing the assessment, but
not more than 5 years following submission of the preceding report of assessment, certifying the results of the
assessment.
